The API and runtime layer for the ARPA-H CIRCLE program **INFLECT**. A
[Process-Bigraph](https://github.com/vivarium-collective/process-bigraph) workspace
that runs the BioGears sepsis model two ways — the real BioGears 8.2.0 engine and an
SBML/Antimony extraction of it — and compares them run-for-run.

| Investigation | Research question |
|---|---|
| [BioGears sepsis core: engine vs SBML extraction _(running)_](https://INFLECT-Praenora.github.io/inflect-sim-core/workbench/reports/investigation-biogears-sbml-sepsis.html) | Does the Antimony/SBML extraction of the BioGears sepsis core reproduce the real BioGears engine run-for-run — not merely against the McDaniel et al. 2019 paper milestones — and where does it diverge… |
<!-- END:investigations -->

Both arms run at matched severities on a common clock. The inflammation core matches
near bit-for-bit; the SBML hemodynamic collapse lags ~11 h under severe sepsis. Study
S4 re-runs the SBML arm under both `process-bigraph` (Python) and `viva-core` (Rust)
and confirms they agree bit-for-bit.

## Run it locally

    bash scripts/serve.sh      # workbench
    pytest                     # fast tests (engine arms: pytest -m slow)

Code lives in `viva_simulation_core/`; `build_core()` in `core.py` registers the
processes and composites.

## Re-running the engine arms

The SBML side and all committed comparison data reproduce without BioGears. The
real-engine arms need BioGears 8.2.0 + pybiogears built from source:

    ~/code/pybiogears/scripts/install_biogears.sh      # -> ~/biogears-8.2.0-install
    CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=~/biogears-8.2.0-install uv pip install -e ~/code/pybiogears
    export BIOGEARS_RUNTIME=~/biogears-8.2.0-install/share/biogears/runtime
